class: Any playbook rule (T-01, T-03, T-07, T-09, T-11, T-13 and every other F-71 crossing rule) on any tracked strategy, live or test data, whose FIRST background check, or a screen check made before that first check, happens after the rule has already crossed: the rule is stored and shown as 'Already true when tracking started' and never flags until it clears, although it was false at the real entry.
mechanism: The entry baseline is not stored at entry. Three callers each choose one at check time: the worker's write (background.py:1207 record_check with scn=None, then adjustment_check.py:535-536 'elif not memory: entry = state') and the worker's own check (background.py:1187 'None if known else state') take the CURRENT state as the entry; the screen uses the fixture entry in test mode and the current state otherwise. held_at_entry is fixed at first insert (playbook_store.py:250-252, migration 0031 trigger), so a baseline taken after a crossing is permanent.

first_seen.where: IC test-data run on the scenario copy (code 514113f1), scratch ISSUES.md issue 65 (PATH-12, PATH-14) and 89 (PATH-15), condor 112 (PATH-13)
first_seen.evidence: SELECT rule_id, held_at_entry, seen_clear FROM public.adjustment_rule_state WHERE strategy_id = 115 (7 Nov 00:4x): T-01, T-03, T-13 held_at_entry=true, seen_clear=false, the three rules the screen showed 'already true' at the 0.87 % gap frame although at the Thursday entry (spot 23,100) none held; condor 113, whose first background check ran at frame 0, flagged T-11 correctly. Independent read-only review 7 Nov 00:1x-00:3x (fresh Opus) traced the three baselines; lines re-read by the lead.

fix_attempt_2026_11_07: Fix batch 1 (branch park/b1-rule-baseline, issue #664, PARKED after 2 rounds): DB seeding + one entry_baseline function + 0045 marker made the core proof pass (restart_first_check=Flag, records_after_new_crossing=1) but broke 11 ADJ-02 tests: the entry state carries no Greeks and no ltp, so T-03 (delta) and T-09 (premium) fall back to the first check (entry_fallback=state) and a rule true NOW is held at entry. ADJ-02 entry (spot 23100, IV 0.13): CE 23500 delta 0.1691, PE 22700 -0.1313 < 0.35; T-09 41.80 vs 3.0: neither held. Lesson: an entry baseline must reproduce every rule input AT ENTRY (model Greeks from entry spot/IV, entry premiums); a first-check fallback re-creates this very class for every Greek/premium rule.
fix: Branch fix/b1-rule-baseline-2 (2026-11-07, not merged): the worker's rule memory is read from the DB at the rebuild (GateLoad.rule_memory); one entry baseline (adjustment_check.entry_baseline: scenario entry, else stored entry facts with their time, else the first check) for screen, recorder and worker; the recorder reads the process scenario as the worker does (it had passed scn=None and stored the CURRENT state as the entry); ADR-258 starting point adjustment_rule_state.adjustment_no (migration 0045); repair tool scripts/repair_rule_entry_baseline.py (dry run default, --apply writes). Round 3 (branch fix/b1-rule-baseline-5, after an independent review): adjustment_check._entry_state gives each short its engine |delta| AT ENTRY (bs_greeks at entry spot and clock, the scenario's entry ATM IV, else the vol solved from the leg's own fill price) and its entry premium as its price; pe.evaluate(entry_fallback=) is deleted, so a rule not computable at entry is not held, never its first-check value. ADJ-02 entry (registry rate 0.065, to 9 Nov 15:30): CE 23500 |delta| 0.1744, PE 22700 0.1352, both < 0.35; T-09 entry price 41.80 vs 3.0.
